meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of sinter.
meaning.vi: Thì quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ của sinter.

meaning_vi: được thiêu kết, được nung kết

sentences.en: The material is then in a partially burnt and slightly sintered state, but it is not fully clinkered and would not make Portland cement.
sentences.vi: Sau đó, vật liệu ở trạng thái cháy một phần và hơi thiêu kết, nhưng nó không kết dính hoàn toàn và sẽ không tạo ra xi măng Pooclăng.

sentences.en: The magnets are either sintered or directionally cast, and then annealed in a magnetic field.

sentences.en: Parallel to the production of high-grade steels is Sheffield's development of sintered carbides for use on tipped cutting tools and in certain dies.

sentences.en: Race Clutch Disk This consists of a steel hub riveted to a steel disk on which eight sintered copper pads are installed.

sentences.en: The stack is then sintered with the electrodes in-situ.

sentences.en: Gold Pads EBC 's Gold compound is a sintered copper alloy material for high durability use in situations requiring long life.

sentences.en: The sintered parts shrink on cooling and shapes are only processed which can be removed from the mold on completion of the process.

sentences.en: Resin Metal Casting The use of sintered metals to give metallic finishes, is a popular and relatively simple process.

sentences.en: Empress 2 consists of lithium disilicate glass ceramic as framework material (Figure 12) which is then coated with sintered glass ceramic.
